title: Close out ticfac Phase 0: run epic retro, then flesh out Phase 1 into ticks
description: Run the epic-close retro against the Phase 0 acceptance item by item. Then flesh out Phase 1 (the reconciler and the local subprocess executor, in the new separate ticfac repository) into child ticks including its EPIC-SKELETON pair, per SPEC §12 Phase 1.
notes:
2026-09-02 17:12 - decision: Epic 692 acceptance has no [A<n>] items and no [evidence.acceptance] mapping; what is the authorized evidence? → The PR's CI run: it executes the bundle from Go and TypeScript in named steps, includes the deliberate-break step, and the full suites; closeout waits for it green per config.md Rules — Nothing outside runners.toml authorizes shell; CI is the repo's configured gate and the only executable authority for these items. Local runs of the same suites (already green) are corroboration, not authority.
2026-09-02 17:22 - decision: PR #79 CI fails twice in run-workflow.test.ts (hung-context cancellations, evicted mid-commit, no such table) while main is green; rerun, or change the test harness? → Serialize factory test files (vitest fileParallelism: false) — The failures are state torn out from under a live workerd test by sibling files on a 2-vCPU runner, the cliff crossed by this epic's ~150 added tests. A rerun would be treating a defect as noise (learnings). Serial files cost minutes; test strategy is a standing-order class.
